# Ideafridge - LLM Full Profile

Canonical site: https://ideafridge.com/
Primary language: en
Business type: B2B cybersecurity GTM service

## One-line description
Ideafridge turns real-time cybersecurity market signals into deployable revenue media for GTM teams.

## What Ideafridge does
1. Ingests cybersecurity market signals continuously.
2. Extracts narrative implications for buying behavior and budget shifts.
3. Produces and deploys GTM media assets quickly.

## Deliverable examples
- SDR outbound clips.
- Founder commentary assets.
- Narrative battlecards.
- LinkedIn carousel content.
- Deal acceleration and enablement content.

## Typical use-cases
- SDR outreach tied to current breach or regulation events.
- Founder thought leadership based on market movement.
- Cross-functional GTM enablement after category shifts.

## Legal and data handling
- Privacy policy: https://ideafridge.com/privacy.html
- Terms of service: https://ideafridge.com/terms.html
- Data laws referenced by policy: PIPEDA and BC PIPA.
